title: Replace Text (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Replace Text applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Replace Text (BtnApplyTextTool) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Replace Text from First Selected anchors on shapes[1] and replaces collectable ranges
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host the first selected shape becomes the text anchor: its text reaches the second text shape and all nine cells of the selected 3x3 table (no cell selected -> the table is replaced as a whole), the two-shape group is not recursed so its child texts stay 'group_child_a_before'/'group_child_b_before', the anchor keeps its own text, the run reports execution and writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry.

scenarios.title: Replace Text from Last Selected anchors on shapes[shapes.Count] and replaces collectable ranges
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host the last selected shape becomes the text anchor: its text reaches the second text shape and all nine cells of the selected 3x3 table (no cell selected -> the table is replaced as a whole), the two-shape group is not recursed so its child texts stay 'group_child_a_before'/'group_child_b_before', the anchor keeps its own text, the run reports execution and writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry.
